messages:
maria-ops: NA1 edge racks (edge-11/12) showing intermittent packet drops and delayed heartbeats. 95th token latency for text-gen up ~3x since 13:02 UTC. P50 is fine. Runtime logs show batch queue stalls after the recent allocator change. Can runtime + infra triage? @devon-runtime @kevin-sre

kevin-sre: Seen the alerts. Network team already flagged flaps on edge-12. Reproducing TCP retransmits in captures. Will check BGP/underlay with provider.

devon-runtime: Looking at runtime metrics: batch queue depth rising, KV cache eviction spikes, and `alloc` kernel paths logging timeouts. Hypothesis: allocator change + transient network jitter causing scheduler backpressure. Suggest-disable batching heuristic on NA1 and shift traffic off NA1 for non-critical routes.

aj-eng: Agreed. Can we set router weights to prefer NA2 for best-effort traffic? Also how fast can warmpool spin up extra capacity in NA2?

warmpool-bot: Warmpool status: na2 -> 12 ready, 8 offline. Provisioning ETA for +16 GPUs: ~6 minutes.

kevin-sre: I'm pushing a temporary routing weight change: na1 weight 0.25 -> 0.05 for best-effort. Running diagnostics on edge-12 now.

devon-runtime: I'll queue an emergency rollback of commit `opt/alloc-17959` that introduced the allocator tweak. Also prepared a runtime feature flag: `RUNTIME_BATCH_DEGRADE=1` to force per-request dispatch while we investigate. If we rollback we should purge stale KV segments to avoid replays.

maria-ops: Do the rollback + set the flag on NA1. Add a short-lived routing rule: `service-routing set --region na1 --min-weight 5` so critical traffic still uses NA1.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: rollback opt/alloc-17959 -> estimate 4m. Notifying canaries.

anya-ml: Note: disabling batching will reduce throughput ~15-25% depending on workload. Expect unit-cost increase while workaround in place.

kevin-sre: Provider ticket opened for edge-12 BGP flap. Also confirmed a partial isolation between leafs causing increased inter-rack latency for KV streams.

devon-runtime: Applied `RUNTIME_BATCH_DEGRADE=1` on NA1 instances and executed KV purge: ```rdm purge --prefix kvcache/na1 --confirm``` Batch queues dropped immediately on metric dashboards.

maria-ops: Traffic shift working: 95th latency down from ~1.6s -> ~0.95s for affected routes. Error rate trending down. @aj-eng please hold autoscale changes for 10 minutes while we stabilize.

aj-eng: Holding. Also provisioning +4 reserved GPUs in NA2 to handle uplift. Cost estimate: temporary +$2.4k/day while hot.

kevin-sre: Rollback completed, canaries stable, BGP flaps persist (provider investigating). Keeping batch degrade flag on NA1 until we confirm no re-trigger. Opening incident INC-2026-179600 for tracking.

maria-ops: Action items captured: 1) packet-captures on edge-11/12 (kevin) 2) add routing fallback when KV thrash detected (aj) 3) add synthetic batch sanity preflight for runtime deploys (anya) 4) postmortem owner (maria). Anything else?

anya-ml: I'll own synthetic batch tests and schedule a run in ~2h.

devon-runtime: I'll add a guard in the batch scheduler: if queue depth > 500 then automatically set degrade mode and emit alert. PR will be up today.

maria-ops: Great. Will update INC ticket and post interim status in #incidents. Thanks all :thumbsup:
